title: rubus irroratus
intro: Rubus irroratus, commonly known as the Himalayan Raspberry, is a type of shrub native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its edible fruits, which are rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, and are believed to offer various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Rubus irroratus include its use as an antimicrobial agent, antidiarrheal, and anti-inflammatory, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Rubus irroratus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
